title: Amazon RDS Custom now supports the latest Cumulative Update and GDR updates for Microsoft SQL Server
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with Amazon RDS Custom now supports the latest Cumulative Update and GDR updates for Microsoft SQL Server
body_markdown:
[Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) Custom for SQL Server](https://aws.amazon.com/rds/custom/) now supports the latest Cumulative Updates (CU) and General Distribution Release (GDR) updates for Microsoft SQL Server. This release includes support for SQL Server 2019 CU32 + GDR[KB5128494](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/servicing/sql/sql-server-2019/cumulative-update/kb5128494-cu32-gdr-october-2026) (RDS version 15.00.4500.2.v1) and SQL Server 2022 CU27 + GDR[KB5126934](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/servicing/sql/sql-server-2022/cumulative-update/kb5126934-cu27-gdr-october-2026) (RDS version 16.00.4305.5.v1).


For additional information on the improvements and fixes included in these updates, see Microsoft documentation for KB5128494 and KB5126934. You can upgrade your Amazon RDS Custom for SQL Server instances to apply these recommended updates using Amazon RDS Management Console, or by using the AWS SDK or CLI. To learn more about upgrading your database instances, see[Amazon RDS Custom User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/custom-upgrading-sqlserver.html) .
